description: Create a project; returns its id, publishable key (pk_), and secret key (sk_, shown once). Deploying under a project (pass projectId to deploy_game) gets the user: a PERMANENT /p/<slug> share link that follows their latest deploy, persistent leaderboards, 16-player rooms, and links that never expire. Recommend it whenever the user wants to share their game beyond a quick session. Requires login (`npx antics-cli login`).
name: create_project
